AccessEvidence.personalSpaceId: null unless positive original native personal-space provenance for this account/network exists
AccessEvidence.value: null or original Private0/Personal1/Shared2; no fallback ordinal

CoordinatorSnapshot.fetchedAt: RFC3339Nano time successful coordinator response was observed; unchanged on cached read/failure
CoordinatorSnapshot.status: original coordinator SpaceStatus.String() enum label, not a Heart/Any ordinal

ObjectRuntimeState.capturedAt: RFC3339Nano new sample time; never silently Heart syncDate

ObjectSyncObservation.lastSyncAt: null or actual original tracker lastApplied / inherited lastAllSyncedAt; basis identifies origin

SpaceRuntimeState.capturedAt: RFC3339Nano timestamp of this sample, not fetchedAt

SpaceSyncObservation.lastSyncedAt: null or actual original tracker lastSync time
SpaceSyncObservation.networkProtocolIncompatible: bool from existing original incompatibility callback

currentAuthority: same App token, concrete Space token, ACL identity/head and read permission before/after; zero result on refusal
explicitAbsenceRules: coordinator null means no accepted answer
limits null means coordinator payload omitted limits
present numeric0 is a real observed zero
personal provenance unavailable remains access.value null
unknown/offline must not be remapped to Heart queued
capturedAt/lastSyncAt must not be silently labelled Heart syncDate

scope.aclHeadId: exact signed head fenced before/after read
scope.authorityIdentity: actual loaded ACL identity, including authorized guest identity
